checklist.question: Who holds the audiovisual rights to this match footage (competition organiser, host club, licensed broadcaster, archive)?
Which copy will be processed, and how was it obtained (official purchase/stream licence, broadcaster archive licence, club licence, operator-owned recording)?
Does acquisition avoid circumventing any download, DRM, account or geo protection? (Must be YES; otherwise processing is refused.)
Do the licence/terms permit computational analysis (frame decoding, derived event data)?
What may be published: derived event data only, short clips/frames, nothing? Under which exception or licence?
Has legal counsel or the rights holder confirmed R4/R5 in writing? (The pipeline makes no legal determination.)

processing_rule: Pipeline refuses this video until rights_status is OPEN_LICENSE, LICENSED or OPERATOR_ATTESTED_LAWFUL_ACCESS with attestation, acquisition_method is admissible and download_protection_circumvented is false.
counterfactual_rule: 'If played today' analysis is a separate COUNTERFACTUAL_MODEL_LAYER and never edits observed rows.
